projects.title: Global Location Finder
projects.description: Built a web application that allows users to search and pinpoint locations using real-time geolocation APIs and interactive map integration (Google Maps/Mapbox). Implemented search autocomplete, user location tracking, and marker clustering for enhanced usability. Focused on performance and responsive UI using modern front-end technologies.

projects.title: 108 Helpline App
projects.description: Designed and developed an Android-based emergency response application to accurately determine a user's geolocation and seamlessly share it with the nearest available ambulance and hospital. The core functionality of the application enabled real-time victim location tracking on the ambulance’s device while efficiently transmitting critical user details to nearby hospitals, ensuring a swift and coordinated emergency response.
